item.title: Extending Open Source Software with AI While Keeping Ties with Upstream
item.description:
While maintaining BlankOn Linux for years, I used to patch upstream software in favor of:

  1. Bug fixes
  2. Rebranding
  3. Extending some features / functionalities

Bug fixes are usually already handled by our upstream (Debian Sid), and we rarely patch the software by ourselves. Rebranding tends to be easy too because the strings that need to be rebranded usually stay the same in the same file / line number for a long time. Both are maintained via Debian patches using quilt.

item.title: When AI Makes Ordinary Life Feel Good
item.description:
I have never been able to focus on work with AI. Whenever I work with an AI agent, I always tend to multitask. Maybe this is part of the lowest spectrum of ADHD, a part of myself that I can’t avoid.

It is not a pleasant feeling or experience to work with multiple agents. You can name a few best practices about how to work with AI. To some degree, they work. But what we can’t avoid is that they require high attention, which easily makes us very tired.
